The [example](example/index.md) is rendered from this Markdown. The same
file drives the test suite.


## LaTeX output

For LaTeX, the filter emits `amsthm` environments:

```sh
pandoc -L amsthm.lua model-source.md --top-level-division=chapter --toc -N -o model-latex.tex
```

``` {.latex include="../tests/model-latex.tex"}
```

Typeset, this gives [this PDF](example.pdf).
